_meta.purpose: BUILT universe of validated non-US-situs candidate lines. Do not hand-edit -- edit data/ucits_seed.json and rebuild.
_meta.refresh_cadence: Static snapshot. The UCITS universe is near-static -- expense ratios move about once a year and launches trickle. This is deliberately NOT wired into the weekly price Action; refresh manually at the quarterly review.
_meta.situs_basis: UCITS status, read from the fund's legal name. A fund cannot be both UCITS-authorised and US-domiciled, so this settles the estate-tax verdict structurally. ETCs are not UCITS funds and are marked situs=unresolved.
_meta.withholding_basis: Irish domicile from the fund-family string only. Unverified lines carry 30 per cent, the conservative direction, and MUST be rendered with a verify flag rather than asserted.
